headline: British Columbia sues OpenAI over school shooting
summary: British Columbia has sued OpenAI, alleging a mass shooting at a Tumbler Ridge school could have been prevented if the company had warned authorities about the shooter's ChatGPT use.

claims.statement: British Columbia has sued OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge school shooting.
